_comment: Proper nouns that must never be respelled, in any locale. Institution names, study names, brand names and citations are what they are called, not a spelling choice. Read by build/migrate.py, build/extract-strings.py and kwik-fat-cut-i18n.js, so one entry covers the normaliser, the audit and the runtime transform.
_examples: World Health Organization keeps the z even in British copy.
Labour Party would keep the u even in American copy.
Rush Memory and Aging Project is the study's registered name.
phrases: Center for Disease Control and Prevention
